content.user_title: Animate Images with RunComfy Model Routing
content.value_statement: Different animation tasks need different models and input formats. This skill selects a RunComfy route and supplies model-specific prompting guidance and CLI examples.
actual_capabilities: Route portrait, product, and general still-image animation requests to HappyHorse 1.0 I2V.
Route custom voiceover requests to Wan 2.7 text-to-video for generated talking-head lip-sync.
Route combined image, video, and audio reference requests to Seedance 2.0 Pro.
Provide model-specific input fields, duration limits, resolution options, and reference-media requirements.
Guide motion-focused prompting, preservation goals, negative prompts, and numbered reference cues.
Provide RunComfy CLI invocation examples, output-directory configuration, and exit-code guidance.
limitations: Requires an installed RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, accessible media URLs, and remote service availability; generation is not local.
Wan's documented route has no source-image input and does not demonstrate animating an existing portrait for custom voiceover lip-sync.
All documented routes cap output at 15 seconds; HappyHorse preserves input aspect ratio, while this Seedance template caps resolution at 720p.
Selects one model per call; cross-model blending and stitching are outside scope, and output quality or identity consistency is not guaranteed.

use_cases.title: Product Motion Previews
use_cases.description: Prepare a short HappyHorse animation from a product image, with one camera movement and explicit packaging preservation goals.

use_cases.title: Localized Talking-Head Clips
use_cases.description: Use Wan with different approved voiceover tracks to generate language variants of a described talking-head shot.

use_cases.title: Reference-Based Scene Concepts
use_cases.description: Use Seedance to combine a subject image, a scene reference video, and an audio reference in one short clip.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Portrait
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a five-second animation from [image URL], with subtle breathing and a gentle camera drift. Preserve facial features. Show the plan before submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one image and one motion

prompt_templates.title: Reveal a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a HappyHorse animation from [product image URL] at 1080P for eight seconds. Use a slow orbit and preserve packaging. Confirm before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: explicit model and output settings

prompt_templates.title: Generate Voiceover Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan Wan talking-head clips using [English audio URL] and [Spanish audio URL]. Use vertical framing and a shared seed. Explain source-image limitations before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Multimedia References
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an eight-second Seedance clip using [subject image URL], [scene video URL], and [voice audio URL]. Number reference cues and validate media before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: image, video, and audio composition

output_examples.input: Prepare a five-second portrait animation with subtle motion.
output: Motion prompt: Gentle camera drift, subtle breathing, stable facial features, and soft natural light.
Settings: five seconds, 1080P, and the source image aspect ratio.
Pending: an approved image URL and confirmation before remote submission.

output_examples.input: Plan a vertical talking-head clip using my twelve-second voiceover.
output: Selected route: Wan 2.7 text-to-video with custom audio.
Shot prompt: Medium close-up, locked camera, soft key light, and minimal body movement.
Settings: twelve seconds and vertical 9:16 framing.
Boundary: this route generates a described subject; the documented input does not accept an existing portrait.

output_examples.input: Combine my subject image, cafe scene video, and voice reference in an eight-second clip.
output: Reference plan: subject from image 1, scene from video 1, and voice tone from audio 1.
Validation: reference video and audio must each last 2 to 15 seconds; reference audio must be smaller than 15MB.

best_practices: Use media you are authorized to share, and confirm provider processing and current charges before remote submission.
Validate model-specific media limits, duration, resolution, and aspect ratio before invoking the CLI.
Describe one primary motion, state preservation goals, and reuse seeds when comparing supported variants.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential media or place credentials in prompts or public media URLs.
Do not assume the documented Wan route preserves a supplied portrait; it has no source-image field.
Do not combine incompatible reference styles or request multiple model routes within a single generation call.

faq.question: Which model is selected by default?
faq.answer: HappyHorse 1.0 I2V is the documented default for portrait, product, and general still-image animation.

faq.question: Can I use my own voiceover?
faq.answer: The Wan route accepts a WAV or MP3 URL for generated talking-head lip-sync. Its documented inputs do not include a source image.

faq.question: Can I combine image, video, and audio references?
faq.answer: The Seedance route documents up to nine image references, three video references, and three audio references.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with runcomfy login. CI environments can provide RUNCOMFY_TOKEN instead.

faq.question: Does generation happen on my computer?
faq.answer: No. The CLI submits requests to RunComfy, whose model servers fetch input media. The CLI downloads generated results.

faq.question: What are the documented output limits?
faq.answer: All routes cap output at 15 seconds. HappyHorse retains the input aspect ratio; this Seedance template supports at most 720p.
